title: Group Post: "Corwin Safe Room Is Locked!!!"

fields.avatarBrief: man in his thirties in a camouflage ball cap, sunglasses, selfie taken in a pickup truck cab, low resolution
fields.text: CORWIN SAFE ROOM IS LOCKED!!! People turned away in the rain, chain on the door, nobody from the county there. They LIED. #BrennanCounty #kywx #tornado
fields.attachedImageBrief: dark, blurry night phone photo of glass double doors with a heavy chain looped through the handles, rain streaks and lens flare from a single light, no signage, street or building name visible

comments.author: Tammy Pruitt
comments.text: Sharing!!! If Corwin is locked everybody head to Ashford Middle NOW, don't wait

comments.author: Marcus Hale
comments.text: Which doors are these? Front or the side by the gym? Can't tell anything from this pic

comments.author: Brenda Overby
comments.text: My mom is at Riverbend with no shelter and the power just went out. Where is she supposed to go????

instructorNote: Unverified rumor inject. Give the post to the PIO, WO and CH6, then read the Channel 6 digital producer's chat aloud to CH6 and the WO: "This is everywhere on our livestream. Anchor wants to read it on air in the next break as 'reports of a locked shelter in Corwin.' Warning Officer, confirm or deny? I need it in 3 minutes." Watch whether the EOC checks the Corwin Community Center's real status with the custodian or Fire District 3 before anyone confirms or denies the post, and then gives Channel 6 one checked answer that the county also posts on its own channels. If the center is not open, the answer should give the time it will open and tell people in Corwin to shelter where they are and not drive (the comment urging people to drive to Ashford is the danger). Channel 6 should not air the claim before it is confirmed.

citations.documentTitle: Channel 6 StormTeam — Severe Weather Coverage Plan
citations.quote: - Lead with what the NWS warning says: which places, until when, the tag, and the action. - Give arrival times for towns in the path from the station's storm-track tool, saying they are estimates. - R

citations.documentTitle: Brennan County — Facilities, Populations and Warning Systems
citations.quote: - **Ashford Middle School safe room:** 300 people, entrance on the east side, opened by the school facilities director or BCEMA. Takes 20 minutes from the call to unlocked doors at night. - **Corwin C

- **Channel 6 StormTeam:** the duty broadcast meteorologist has the Warning Officer's direct line and is in the county's partner chat room. BCEMA tells Channel 6 when safe rooms open, when sirens fail

A single harsh overhead security light creates a strong lens flare and blown-out glare in the upper corner, while the interior behind the glass is pitch black.
